changelog:
Initial release—auto-generates high-quality README.md files tailored to project type.

- Writes production-ready READMEs from code, description, or an existing README.
- Adapts sections for libraries, CLIs, web apps, APIs, and data pipelines.
- Enforces clear, concise writing with concrete usage examples and coding standards.
- Omits irrelevant sections and marketing jargon; focuses on maintainers’ real needs.
- Supports configuration for project type, audience, language/framework, license, and badges.
summary: Generate a complete, production-quality README.md from code, description, or an existing README, tailored to the project type without any filler content.
